description: Wärmenetzpotenzial Gemeinden Szenario 2 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.saarland.de. The basis for interpreting and understanding the presented results is the final report of the study "Wärmewende im Saarland – Status quo, potentials and fields of action (www.saarland.de/waermewende). The layer shows an overview of the heat grid potentials in Saarland in the two modelled scenarios at the municipal level. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heat grid potential municipalities Scenario 2" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ENER, ECON, Saarland, opendata. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
